ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity black pixels across approximately 85-90% of the visible surface, with high-intensity white pixels localized in linear and punctate formations.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary dark pigmentation baseline. High-contrast white contiguous banding is concentrated in the lower proximal quadrants of both lobes. Scattered high-intensity white punctate spots are distributed across the medial and distal regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression with a narrow angular vertex; depth extends significantly into the central fluke mass.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular serrations characterized by multiple jagged peaks and valleys across the continuous trailing edge of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Overall convex sweep from the median notch, transitioning to a sharp upward concavity at the distal lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct high-contrast white circular ring near the lower-center of the left lobe. Dense, irregular high-intensity clusters (barnacle colonization) localized on the extreme lateral tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Highly visible clusters of parallel, horizontal-to-diagonal white linear disruptions (rake marks) on the lower regions of both lobes, specifically 5-6 parallel lines on the left lobe and 4-5 on the right.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake marks on lower lobes and heavy barnacle encrustation on the lateral lobe tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-intensity circular ring scar located on the lower interior portion of the left lobe lobe proximal to the notch.
